oracle.method: Separate Python integer arithmetic plus explicit source script ordering generates checked-in literal JSON. It imports no application, probe, compiled-module or extraction code. Hand-checked miss/critical/terminal/status-block/resume anchors are asserted before writing.

isolation.expectation: Every step matches the same literal standalone transcript, including RNG and all party summaries.

limitations: Separate host scheduler is bounded to admitted single-battle choices; it is not an arbitrary original script interpreter.
No abilities, helditems, weather, badges, screens, doubles, toxic counters, paralysis/confusion/sleep, othermoves, PP Ups, Struggle, experience or durable domain effects.
The separate fixtureoracle intentionally models no unsupported branch; adapter rejection and noncommitting failure paths require runtime tests.
Independent goldens support representative batch2 verification only. Productionportable snapshots/replay/resource workloadgate and ADR-001 selection remain batch3.
